comparison.boundary: first tested epsilon with all six seed AUC>=0.99; exact cells only
comparison.five_pp_context: first adjacent EXP-014 damage crossing; exact lower/upper ADS-L4 AUC cells only

adaptive.baseline: same PE/seed CE-only EXP-014 curve plus clean anchor
adaptive.crossing: first adjacent crossing in ascending epsilon; exact hit direct; linear in damage; no extrapolation
adaptive.profile: same interpolation weight for all 12 ADS layers
adaptive.profile_target: T*logsumexp(interpolated layer ADS/T), T=0.01, raw additive constant retained
adaptive.ratio: adaptive reference target / damage-matched CE target
adaptive.marker: exists positive-lambda state with damage>=D and ratio<=0.5, D in {5,10}; no lambda/epsilon interpolation

reference_sensitivity.status: cohort-sensitivity diagnostic; seed remains model-level replicate

stage_B.B1: saved-delta accuracy on exactly 4744 non-reference validation images
stage_B.B2: saved-delta four-score benign-aware evaluation on prespecified disjoint 256-image holdout for all four PE families
